items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: after you play with fellas like Ricky Tom, Stale, and Dave Perkins

ctx.x: Well, there's so many people like that that have forgotten. Like you were talking about Ricky Tom. I don't even know where he was from.
Well, from New Orleans as long as I know him. He played with Papa Lane way back too, Ricky.
And Melvin Berry, that was another one that I hear people talk about.
